suppress.notes: False positive. CVE-2026-53914 is in the Kotlin Gradle Plugin (build-time cache deserialization), not in the kotlin-stdlib runtime library. Matched only by the jetbrains:kotlin CPE. Agreed by: Ezekiel Maroclo-Kemmerling (@ezekemm) Ethan Kish (@ekish33). Review by: 2026-10-07.

False positive. CVE-2022-31691 affects Spring Tools 4 for Eclipse (4.16.0 and below) and some VS Code extensions, not spring-boot-devtools. Matched only because the CPE spring_tools shares the number 4.1.1. Devtools is also optional and excluded from the repackaged jar. Agreed by: Ezekiel Maroclo-Kemmerling (@ezekemm) Ethan Kish (@ekish33). Review by: 2026-10-07.

Not applicable. CVE-2026-41115 is the Kafka broker validating the wrong ACL permission for the CONSUMER_GROUP_DESCRIBE API (Apache Kafka CVE list, affects 4.0.0 to 4.3.0). The application bundles only the client libraries (kafka-clients and kafka-streams) and does not run a broker. Pinned to this version so a Kafka upgrade is reviewed again. Agreed by: Ezekiel Maroclo-Kemmerling (@ezekemm) Ethan Kish (@ekish33). Review by: 2026-10-07.
